title: maint.event.v1{kind=verify_forensic_captured}
description: Phase 8 §8.15.10 Fix C — emitted by maint.backup.v1 when a failed restore-verify writes a forensic sidecar JSON to <date>.failed/verify_forensic.json. Notification-only; no ack expected.

target.description: ISO calendar date (UTC) of the dump whose verify failed, matching the <date>.failed/ directory name.

size_bytes.description: Actual size in bytes of the verify_forensic.json file written to disk.

pg_restore_exit_code.description: Exit code from pg_restore; null when not applicable.
